description: A one-row footer for Svelte 5 built from the SvGrid UI kit: the copyright year on the left and Privacy, Terms and Status links on the right, with a green Operational SvBadge on the Status link. On phones the row stacks with the links above the copyright.

faq.question: How do I change the links?
faq.answer: Pass links to createSimpleFooter(), an array of { label, href, status? }. A link with status: true gets a green SvBadge reading Operational after its label.

faq.question: Does it mark the current page?
faq.answer: Yes, when you pass currentPath. linkProps(link) sets aria-current="page" on the link whose href matches it, for example page.url.pathname from $app/state.

faq.question: How does it change on a phone?
faq.answer: Below 560 px the footer switches to a reversed column, so the three links sit above the copyright, both aligned left.
